name: 2069-longdecode-mixtral8x7b-8gpu
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3 -- one whole a3 node.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1 -- one engine spread across the whole node.
architecture: sparse mixture-of-experts decoder (MixtralForCausalLM), unquantized bf16 -- ~93 GB of weights, ~11.6 GB per card at TP=8.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams = 1, warmup 20%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 30 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, `request_format: plain`, fixed by construction at 64 prompt tokens and 512 output tokens (min=max on both); temperature 0.75, top_p 1.0; `ignore_eos` is forced, so every request emits exactly 512 tokens.
purpose: A long-form creative writing assistant on a large mixture-of-experts model, serving one user's short prompts across eight GPUs.
launch:
# vLLM 0.2.4-era AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# Do not add keys from a later vLLM -- chunked prefill, prefix caching and enforce-eager
# do not exist on this engine.

model: mistralai/Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1
tensor-parallel-size: 8
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
